title: Runbooks

Runbooks

Runbooks are step-by-step operational guides for handling incidents, deployments, and maintenance tasks.

A good runbook:

  • Has a clear trigger condition ("when to use this")

  • Lists all prerequisites (access, tools, context)

  • Has numbered steps with expected outputs

  • Includes a rollback section

  • Has been tested recently (check the last_tested date)devos://page/01HWKP1234567890PAGERUN0
